title: PopescuCoefficientRescaling
statement:
Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, A:Type v a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ:Type w a Noetherian geometrically regular k-algebra, α:A→ₐ[k]Λ, and q∈Spec Λ. Put L=Λ_q. Let N>0 with m_L^N contained in the extension to L of α(singularIdeal k A), d=spanFinrank(m_L), a:Fin s→A generating singularIdeal k A, c>0, and n₀=N+d(8c). Fix a surjective polynomial presentation f:k[z_i:i∈Fin r]→A. Fix φ₀:k[y_i:i∈Fin m₀]→Λ and its localized map ψ₀:P₀=(k[y_i])_(φ₀⁻¹q)→L, commuting with the polynomial map. Suppose ψ₀ is flat and the contracted prime extends to m_L. Fix a local Artinian ring D₀:Type(max u w), with a local essentially smooth algebra structure over P₀/(φ₀⁻¹q P₀)^n₀ and a flat local homomorphism g₀:D₀→L/m_L^n₀, such that the quotient diagram commutes and each α(f(z_i)) modulo m_L^n₀ is in the range of g₀. All notions are those of the statement-dependency nodes.
There exist compatible polynomial k-algebra maps S=k[X_i:i∈Fin d]→R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m]→Λ, rho:Fin d→R, and ell:Fin d×Fin s→Λ, with rho_i=image(X_i), image(X_i)^(2N)=sum_j ell(i,j)α(a_j), image(rho_i)∈q, and equal first and square multiplication kernels on R and Λ modulo preceding (8c)-th powers. Put P=k[y_i:i∈Fin m₀], p₀=φ₀⁻¹q, n=N+d(8c), B=P/p₀^n, L=Λ_q, K=m_L^n. There are E:R≃ₐ[k]P[t_i:i∈Fin d], uP:Fin d→p₀, and tΛ:Fin d→Λ with tΛ_i∉q, such that uP generates p₀P_(p₀), E(rho_i)=uP_i t_i, and R→Λ sends E⁻¹(C z) to φ₀(z) and E⁻¹(t_i) to tΛ_i. There is a local Artinian k-algebra D:Type(max u v), compatibly a B-algebra, essentially smooth over B, with f₀:A→ₐ[k]D and a flat local homomorphism g:D→L/K (a local ring). There are units δ:Fin d→Dˣ and coeff:Fin d×Fin s→D, such that g(image(z mod p₀^n))=φ₀(z) mod K, g(δ_i)=tΛ_i mod K, g(f₀(x))=α(x) mod K, and g(coeff(i,j))=ell(i,j) mod K. No ideal H or quotient equivalence R/H^n≃B[t] is asserted. All definitions are those of the statement dependency nodes.

source.place: Lemma 07FJ, lemma-resolve-general, item-choose-pii, item-modify-pii, item-choose-deltai, item-set-map-R

proof.text: Apply the polynomial-kernel-parameters theorem with e=c*8, positive because c>0. It chooses uP in the contracted prime generating its localized maximal ideal, regular in L, and supplies the first/square kernel equality on the iterated polynomial ring P[t].
Apply the fixed-parameter coefficient induction to those uP. Retain tLambda, ell, the Lambda kernel equality, and the local Artinian coefficient ring and all maps, units and coefficients.

Set m=d+m0 and use renameEquiv for Fin(d+m0) equivalent to Fin d plus Fin m0, followed by sumAlgEquiv, to obtain E:R equivalent to P[t]. Put rho_i=E inverse(C(uP_i)t_i). Define R to Lambda by evaluation composed with E, S to R by aeval rho, and S to Lambda by their composite; IsScalarTower.of_algHom and the composition equality give all scalar towers. Evaluation of rho is phi0(uP_i)tLambda_i, so the power relations and prime membership follow. For each preceding ideal, E maps its generating set exactly to the corresponding set in P[t]. Use Ideal.quotientEquiv to transport multiplication and its square, proving the R kernel equality. Rewrite the Lambda preceding ideal using the evaluation identity and identify the R action with its Lambda algebra-map action, yielding its kernel equality. Evaluation after E inverse on constants and variables gives the required chart compatibility. Retain the coefficient data unchanged.

theorem exists_popescu_coefficient_rescaling
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) k →ₐ[k] A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (m₀ : ℕ) (φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (ψ₀ : Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    (hψ₀ : ψ₀.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))) =
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hideal₀ : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom))
    (hflat₀ : ψ₀.Flat)
    (D₀ : Type (max u w)) [CommRing D₀] [IsLocalRing D₀] [IsArtinianRing D₀]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀]
    (g₀ : D₀ →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      (q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)]
    [IsLocalHom g₀]
    (hsmooth₀ : EssentiallySmooth
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)
    (hgflat₀ : g₀.Flat)
    (hfactor₀ : (g₀.comp (algebraMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c)))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c)))).comp ψ₀)
    (hinc₀ : ∀ i : Fin r, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (α (f (MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∈
        Set.range g₀) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ) (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ)
      (rho : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
    (rho = fun i ↦ algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap S Λ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
      ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧ y = rho j ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho j) ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let P := MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k
    let p₀ := q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom
    let B := P ⧸ p₀ ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    let K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    ∃ (E : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin d) P)
      (uP : Fin d → P) (tΛ : Fin d → Λ),
      (∀ i, uP i ∈ p₀) ∧
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ algebraMap P (Localization.AtPrime p₀) (uP i))) =
        p₀.map (algebraMap P (Localization.AtPrime p₀)) ∧
      (∀ i, tΛ i ∉ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ i, E (rho i) = MvPolynomial.C (uP i) * MvPolynomial.X i) ∧
      (∀ z : P, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (E.symm (MvPolynomial.C z)) =
        φ₀ z) ∧
      (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) = tΛ i) ∧
      ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : IsLocalRing D)
        (_ : IsArtinianRing D) (_ : Algebra k D) (_ : Algebra B D)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k B D),
        EssentiallySmooth B D ∧
        ∃ (f₀ : A →ₐ[k] D) (g : D →+* L ⧸ K)
          (δ : Fin d → Dˣ) (coeff : Fin d × Fin s → D),
          IsLocalRing (L ⧸ K) ∧ IsLocalHom g ∧ g.Flat ∧
          (∀ z : P, g (algebraMap B D (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p₀ ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) z)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (φ₀ z))) ∧
          (∀ i, g (δ i : D) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (tΛ i))) ∧
          (∀ x, g (f₀ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
          (∀ ij, g (coeff ij) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
